label: nyiso 69 dr reserve
definition: nyiso-69: nyiso-68 SCR/EDRP keeper + one structural lever, nyiso_dr_reserve_eligible — the NYISO SCR/EDRP demand-response blocks made 30-minute (class-0) operating-reserve eligible (reserve_config._nyiso_reserve_eligible, thermal ∪ demand_response; the CAISO hydro-reserve seam analogue), never the 10-min quick-start (class-1) set (rule 12, physics-gated). Diagnosed via an instrumented per-family reserve-dual dump that SENY-30min carries 85% of the 2023 failing-hour reserve dual; the added downstate SCR reserve supply relieves it. Zero new residual DOF (n_residual stays 5), no residual tuning. DETERMINATION NOT-YET, strictly MORE structurally faithful than nyiso-68 with NO regression: 2023 C3a +17.8%->+16.8%, C3b NRMSE 0.215->0.205, C3c tail 31h->22h (all improved, still fail); 2024 C3c 22h->10h; 2024/2025 C3a/b/c all PASS; C1/C2/C4/C6/C7/C8 PASS; C5a CO2 CAVEAT (2025 +8.3%, commercial band). CORRECTED diagnosis: the 57 reserve-hours are only ~1pp of the +17.8% 2023 mean miss; the DOMINANT 2023 C3a miss is BROAD off-peak trough over-pricing (Mar/May/Jun/Aug/Dec +27-35% vs actual), a 2023-specific energy-side gap (import/hydro/gas-level), NOT reserve scarcity — named in the attestation _open_items.
